mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the route with a realistically loaded trolley was most worthwhile: it turned the mapped solution into a practical check and recorded the remaining difficult corners.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two attempts before discovering that Moth had to produce a route first were frustrating; neither gave useful compatibility guidance.

surprise.text: Moth's shortest route used stairs: it optimized the stated distance but missed the intended movement constraint.

arbitrary.text: Having to generate the unsuitable shortest route before the survey could be used felt somewhat arbitrary, although it served the story's point about missing constraints.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighbors use their evidence to challenge the directory, especially after the route exposed the limits of Moth's original answer.
